outcome: Cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status in labor
Umbilical arterial or venous cord blood pH ≤ 7 and ≤ 7.1
Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit for ≥ 24 h
cohort: 795 singleton pregnancies undergoing induction of labor at ≥ 37 weeks' gestation
finding: Serum PlGF and sFlt-1, measured within 24 h prior to induction of labor, do not provide a significant additional contribution to maternal risk factors in the prediction of adverse perinatal outcome.
